configurations.name: selected
configurations.advantages: Depth normalization, variable RNA and accessible peaks, compact paired inputs; binary accessibility reduces count-depth influence.
configurations.disadvantages: Discards ATAC count magnitude and low-frequency peaks; SVD loses information.
configurations.compute: Sparse selection and two 64-component SVD fits; moderate memory and CPU.

configurations.name: alternative
configurations.advantages: Retains ATAC count magnitude and more features and components.
configurations.disadvantages: More depth sensitivity and substantially higher compute; detection emphasizes common genes.
configurations.compute: Larger sparse matrices and approximately doubled SVD width.

selected_justification.rna_normalization: RNA p90/p10 library size is about 5.2; per-cell library normalization to 10000 and log1p reduce depth and count skew.
selected_justification.rna_selection: Top 2000 training variance genes are a tractable subset of 36601 and prioritize variation; 1374 median genes are detected per sampled cell.
selected_justification.atac_transform: Binary TF-IDF models accessibility presence and discounts widely detected peaks; count p90/p10 is about 5.6, so discarding magnitude limits depth influence.
selected_justification.atac_selection: Frequency selects 12000 of 111743 peaks with training support, balancing sparse coverage and cost; rare signals may be lost.
selected_justification.reduction: 64 components per modality provide compact features for 8776 training cells and limit dense output and model cost; not benchmarked.

rejected_alternatives: The larger alternative has greater compute and may preserve depth effects; no alternatives were benchmarked.
leakage_and_resources: Seeded disjoint cell splits; feature rankings, IDF and SVD fit exclusively on training cells; frozen transforms applied to validation and test. Sparse matrices retained through SVD; no full dense feature matrix.
